reviews.text: I love this place they take care of the fur babies very well and they explain everything and answer any questions u might have.
Taking care of Luna they are doing great 👍 job with caring for animals here! …

We came here for a fixing appointment. The staff was very kind and helpful with questions, despite being busy. I'd be prepared to wait for your pet's intake and pick up, but that is listed in the instructions. I waited about an hour to an hour and a half for each. The instructions and prices are clear, and prices are great if you can't afford a private vet. My pet was clean, well-taken-care-of, and is recovering well. I'm grateful for their services and support in what is a stressful time for pet and owner.
Great for pet care.
They were quick and kind with my beloved pet.
Clean building , staff seemed nice but be prepared to wait hours to be checked in even with appointment.....I just got off work and was no where near expecting it to take that long
I was nervous for my pup being spayed but everyone here was kind and compassionate.
I adopted my dog at the Humane Society and they treated my dog for the 6 months that he was there. They do a great job. Not to long of a wait time. You must make an appointment online.
It was a bit of a long wait, about an hour or so, got there early and there was already a line but process was pretty straightforward, staff was nice

They denied my cat because she "nibbled at the vet" and yes the tech used those exact words. Than proceeds to tell me she was nibbling at the device she was using and not the actual vet. I could understand if my cat was going ballistic but she clearly wasn't. Just say you overbooked instead of blaming my cat. Because any good vet tech wouldn't be scared off by a nibble. Most cats nibble or bite so I suggest training your tech better or finding a new one entirely if they can't handle cats.
The best advice I can give you about this place is go early the line is very long.
The staff is very courteous and professional. They are very helpful and show consideration for your feelings regarding your pet. The building is very clean.

Be prepared to arrive for your appointment and then wait 4 more hours just to check the pet in. They should be doing some people at 7am some at 8am etc because this is absolutely ridiculous. Take work off you'll be here all damn day.
Spay and Neuter services have both been positive experiences for both our babies at this location. Affordable, effective, and efficient.

The front desk staff does not provide the correct information to us. Even when provided with examples they still don't apologize for their mistakes of false information. And they still don't correct the mistakes they make.
I got there early and was 3rd in line, everything seemed to be running efficiently, I got Thelma checked in for her spayed appointment, they said be back at 3:00 p.m. to pick her up.
Great experience getting my dog spayed. She healed up perfectly with no issues. Highly recommend.

Very perfessional.
Very informative and explained procedures.
Very pet friendly and showed kindness to the animals.
Great place to get care for your four legged kids…

We arrived at 7:15 am for the feline Friday spay/neuter event. (Previously made the appointment online). Check in took a little while, but well worth the savings. The facility was clean and the staff was helpful.
Great place! Such kind staff

When I see that the weight of my dog is below 20lbs and the receptionist isn’t willing to explain in an honest manner why my dog jumped up above 20lbs when I pre paid (saying oh they move around), and then assumes I just need to pay with card or cash with out hearing me that I pre paid with the higher weight to get cost of the extras covered with what I paid, seems un honest and not kind.

Care for the animal is ok, but service at front desk is not.

My dog got spayed there and it went well I think.  But the customer service when I went to pick her up was awful. I asked what the name of then medication was because I thought the comfort package was both pain and sedation.  My fault for not reading the packet closer.  But as soon as I asked the name of the medication the lady who was to go over my paperwork was annoyed, sighed and went and got the trazodone and didn’t fill out the prescription all the way and didn’t tell me my dog had staples and sutures.  The paperwork said they would tell you if they had to come back for removal.  This lady didn’t tell me anything so I was surprised when I got an email saying I need to come back.  The lady called me right away when I responded to the email and apologized for the other persons behavior.  She was kind.  If she wasn’t I would have said zero stars.  But I will not be taking my dog back.  I would rather pay more for someone who is caring  than be treated like dog poop.
Very caring staff!
